## Type of Change

## Verification Checklist

- [ ] Code follows project formatting standards (`npm run format:check`)
- [ ] Linter and TypeScript compiler pass with 0 errors/warnings (`npm run lint`)
- [ ] Automated tests cover all changes and 100% pass (`npm test`)
- [ ] All new APIs, configuration options, and behaviors are documented in `README.md`
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` has been updated under `[Unreleased]`
- [ ] Build succeeds for both ESM and CJS distributions (`npm run build`)
